incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-runtime-prod. Alert=High 5xx rate. Policy=runtime-5xx-spike. Incident key=INC-2029-4598. https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/P12345

PagerDuty: Incident triggered and notifications sent to on-call schedule 'runtime-oncall'

Alex Carter: Oncall here — seeing a spike of 5xx from us-west1 cluster. Noticing most errors are 500s from /v1/generate. Investigating. Any recent deploys? :eyes:

Maria Chen: No infra deploys in the last 30m. Autoscaler shows several preemptions in the past 10m. Pulling pod logs now.

Priya Patel: PagerDuty escalated to secondary after no ack within 2m; manager escalation policy also fired (no ack window). @Eve fyi — you got manager escalation.

ops-bot: PagerDuty: Escalation to manager (Eve) fired. Notification sent.

Eve (Oncall Manager): Acking the incident. Taking lead. Setting priority=SEV2 until we confirm customer impact. Alex, can you confirm whether traffic is being routed to a new model variant?

Alex Carter: Checking model routing — looks like ~40% of /v1/generate traffic was shifted to model-server:v2 (quantized) ~7m ago. That aligns with the timing.

Sam Rodriguez: Looking at gateway logs: nginx showing lots of 502/504 upstream errors, but tracing shows 502s are just proxies for backend 500s. Pulling model-server pod logs now. Sample log snippet:
```
2029-06-11T15:04:12Z model-server[pid=4523] ERROR RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory during forward
  File "/srv/runtime/serve.py", line 238, in forward
    out = model(input_ids)
Killed process 4523 (python) total-vm:245000kB, anon-rss:230000kB
```

Maria Chen: Confirmed OOMKilled on 3 of 6 pods in the model-server-v2 replica set. Memory usage jumped after the promoted quantized build (v2) — might be a regression in memory allocation for some sequences. Rolling back one replica to v1 to test.

Alex Carter: If v2 is causing memory churn, we should route traffic to v1-small until we get a fix. I'm updating routing policy to move 100% of /v1/generate to model-variant=v1-small for incoming traffic. Command: `rwctl route update --route /v1/generate --model v1-small --weight 100`

Priya Patel: PagerDuty: Manager (Eve) acknowledged escalation at 15:08:24. Noting customer impact: ~15% error rate for the last 12m across multiple API keys; some customers reported failures in payment-related prompt flows. Logging impact and notifying account execs.

Sam Rodriguez: Started rollback on model-server-v2 -> v1 on the affected nodepool. Rolling restart in progress. Health checks are 302/6 passing so far.

Maria Chen: After rolling restart and routing change, 5xx rate dropped to ~1.2% within 4 minutes. Latency also returned to baseline. Will keep routing in place until we validate a fix for v2.

Eve (Oncall Manager): Good containment. Keep incident open for postmortem. Assigning postmortem owners: Alex Carter, Maria Chen, Sam Rodriguez. @support-team please prepare customer outreach templates.

Alex Carter: :thumbsup: I'll capture timeline and rollback steps. Also will add a temporary autoscaler buffer to reduce preemption susceptibility.

Sam Rodriguez: Confirmed pods stabilized, no further OOMs in last 7m. Will instrument additional memory metrics for v2 testing.

Priya Patel: I'll update the PD incident with the acknowledgment timeline and escalation events, and close manager escalation once postmortem ticket is created.

Eve (Oncall Manager): Handoff: I'm handing incident to Alex for the 09:00 follow-up and postmortem write-up. Leaving incident channel open until action items are tracked.

Alex Carter: On it. Creating incident ticket INC-2029-4598-POSTMORTEM and will include logs, commands, and rollback diffs.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived to incidents backlog with link to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2029-4598-POSTMORTEM

Maria Chen: Quick note for postmortem — surface model binary differences between v1 and v2 quantization paths and any allocator changes.

Eve (Oncall Manager): Thanks team. I'll do a short executive summary for customer ops.
